title.value: Exploring the Wasserstein metric for survival analysis
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and repeated throughout.
title.quote: Exploring the Wasserstein metric for survival analysis

analysis.description: The paper explores the application of the Wasserstein metric for predicting the probability distribution of an event in survival analysis, particularly in the context of right-censored data. It introduces a novel method utilizing a Wasserstein metric combined with the Kaplan-Meier estimator to impute labels for censored examples and compares its effectiveness using several survival datasets.

type.justification: The paper describes experiments conducted using the proposed method and compares its performance on various datasets, which indicates an empirical study.
type.quote: We compared our proposed loss to a set of common ranking-specific losses on several reference survival datasets.

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on developing models for survival analysis, specifically dealing with censored data, which is a key aspect of survival analysis models.
name.quote: Survival analysis aims to predict the first occurrence of a stochastic event, conditioned on a set of features.

name.justification: The paper specifically addresses the challenge of dealing with right-censored data, a common issue in survival analysis.
name.quote: Survival analysis is a type of semi-supervised task where the target output (the survival time) is often right-censored.
